answer: Behavioral entropy auditing flags sybil swarms after the fact. Each identity's action timing and choice distribution feed an entropy score; honest agents show high variance, cloned scripts low. When a cluster's combined score hits a nadir, all linked accounts are frozen pending review. Attacker cost: rebuilding each identity with genuinely irregular behavior, a spiral of manual effort per account. The audit graph traces every shared vertex of timing and sequence overlap, forcing costly divergence per identity.
